dataset.name: AQI Buddy normalised hourly PM2.5 profiles

scenario.name: Delhi-NCR college student's weekday
limitations: This is a hypothetical weekday, not a measured personal diary.
Commutes are simplified as outdoor exposure.
The errand is modelled as an outdoor market activity.
Travel time changes and route-level exposure are not modelled.
The indoor multiplier and activity-intensity factors are assumptions.

modelAssumptions.exposureOutput: Relative exposure index, not a validated personal dose or medical-risk prediction.

inhalationRateSource.name: U.S. EPA Exposure Factors Handbook
inhalationRateSource.table: Table 6-2: Recommended Short-Term Exposure Values for Inhalation
inhalationRateSource.interpretation: U.S. reference rates used to derive relative activity multipliers, not an India-specific personal ventilation estimate.

indoorOutdoorSource.name: IIT Delhi, Monitoring of Air Quality in Urban Indoors in Delhi
indoorOutdoorSource.table: Table 18: Indoor-outdoor ratios in selected microenvironments
indoorOutdoorSource.interpretation: Small, non-random sample from selected Delhi colleges. Used as a sensitivity range, not a universal indoor infiltration factor.

experiment.eligibleTargetDayRule: Every hourly slot from 05:00 through 20:00 must have a valid primary value.
experiment.deployablePolicyRule: Optimise on the mean hour-of-day profile from only the preceding 14 calendar days; require at least 7 valid historical values for each planning hour; score the chosen plan on the target day's observations.
experiment.oraclePolicyRule: Optimise using the target day's actual hourly values; upper-bound comparison, not deployable forecasting.
experiment.randomFeasibleBaselineRule: Exact mean and distribution across every feasible schedule, equivalent to a uniformly random feasible schedule.

stationVsHourSpread.explanation: Descriptive comparison of station-to-station spread at the same hour against within-station hour-of-day spread. It is not a causal estimate of the benefit of changing time versus location.
